name: tany-desktop
description: TANY DESKTOP - local automation companion for TANY (WhatsApp AI assistant). Records and replays routines (web/desktop) and exposes an MCP server for TANY to trigger them.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tany-desktop/shared && npm run build -w @tany-desktop/engine-web && npm run build -w @tany-desktop/engine-desktop && npm run build -w @tany-desktop/mcp-server && npm run build -w @tany-desktop/gui
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @tany-desktop/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tany-desktop/engine-web && npm run typecheck -w @tany-desktop/engine-desktop && npm run typecheck -w @tany-desktop/mcp-server && npm run typecheck -w @tany-desktop/gui
